body.question: Why was the Mars Climate Orbiter lost?
body.synthesized_answer: According to the context, the Mars Climate Orbiter (MCO) was lost due to an abrupt loss of mission shortly after the start of the Mars Orbit Insertion burn on September 23, 1999. The root cause of this mishap was identified as discrepancies between navigation solutions [1]. Specifically, the Doppler-only solutions consistently indicated a flight path insertion closer to the planet than expected, which was not resolved before the loss of mission [2].
